case.convicted: Yes — convicted by the Paris Assize Court, November 24, 1978; France refused extradition and tried the case itself
case.sentence: Convicted by the Paris Assize Court on November 24, 1978, for the July 31, 1972 hijacking of Delta Air Lines Flight 841. In custody at Fleury-Mérogis Prison from his May 26, 1976 arrest in Paris, and released in approximately the spring of 1980 after about three years in total custody. He settled permanently in France.
